title: SimplePro: A Simple Baseline for Proactive Video Understanding
title_zh: SimplePro：主动式视频理解的简单基线
abstract_en: Proactive video understanding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to decide not only what to answer as a video unfolds, but also when newly arrived evidence warrants a response and when to remain silent. Although modern VLMs excel at offline long-video understanding, they struggle in proactive streaming settings, leading prior work to introduce task-specific reinforcement learning or auxiliary triggering modules. We find that explicit reporting rules and structured streaming context substantially improve a frozen VLM's proactive response performance. We exploit this observation to build SIMPLEPRO, a training-free baseline for proactive video understanding. At each decision step, the model combines recent high-resolution frames, bounded historical observations, and prior answer records to determine whether new information warrants a response and, when needed, generate a concise answer. The system then filters consecutive duplicate answers while retaining the raw outputs as context for subsequent decisions. Without any parameter updates or auxiliary triggers, SIMPLEPRO with a 4B backbone consistently outperforms specialized proactive systems across OVO-Bench, StreamingBench-PO, and ProactiveVideoQA. SIMPLEPRO shows overall performance gains as backbone size increases from 2B to 32B. We hope this simple yet effective method will serve as a strong baseline for proactive video understanding, and we will release our code and inference pipeline to support future research.
abstract_zh: 主动式视频理解要求视觉语言模型（VLM）在视频流中不仅判断回答什么，还要判断新证据何时足以触发回答、何时应保持沉默。尽管现有 VLM 擅长离线长视频理解，但在主动流式场景中仍表现有限，因此以往方法往往依赖任务专用的强化学习或辅助触发模块。本文发现，明确的回答规则与结构化的流式上下文可显著改善冻结 VLM 的主动应答表现，并据此提出无需训练的基线 SimplePro。每次决策时，模型结合近期高分辨率帧、有限的历史观测和先前回答记录，判断是否需要回应，并在必要时生成简短回答。系统过滤连续重复的回答，同时保留原始输出供后续决策使用。在不更新参数、不引入辅助触发模块的情况下，采用 4B 骨干模型的 SimplePro 在 OVO-Bench、StreamingBench-PO 和 ProactiveVideoQA 上均优于专用主动应答系统；当骨干模型从 2B 扩展至 32B 时，整体性能有所提升。
key_points_zh: 核心任务不仅是回答正确，还要判断新证据是否足以回应；证据不足时保持沉默。
SimplePro 用明确的回答规则组织近期高分辨率帧、有限的历史观测和先前回答记录，无需更新模型参数或添加辅助触发模块。
系统过滤连续重复的回答，但将未过滤的原始输出保留在后续决策的上下文中。
4B 版本在 OVO-Bench、StreamingBench-PO 和 ProactiveVideoQA 上均优于专用主动应答系统；骨干模型从 2B 扩展到 32B 时，整体性能有所提升。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong training-free baseline shows that explicit reporting rules and bounded context can improve when streaming video agents speak up or stay silent.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这一无需训练的强基线表明，明确的报告规则和有界上下文能帮助流式视频智能体判断何时回应、何时保持沉默。
